title: RelayIQ
sub: Decides whether a lead is worth enriching before you pay for it.

bullets.text: 3.3x lower cost per usable lead on a 495-case seeded benchmark: a multi-step agent routes each field to the best-fit enrichment provider and only spends a credit when it's worth it.
Raised precision from 0.682 to 0.773 across six strategies: calibrated confidence (Brier 0.164, ECE 0.091) holds low-confidence writes back from HubSpot and escalates them to a human in real time.
